foot.note: {lead} {count} repositories across three accounts: {a1}, {a2} and {a3}. Everything is filtered by who actually wrote it. The chart and every sparkline count only my commits, and the two cards marked {shared} say so because I'm not their main author. By that test, {lm} (1 commit of 72), {recap} (none) and the {jj} sites (none) are other people's work and aren't listed, and {fa}'s three public repos are all forks. Repos with a flat bar really are dormant. The {marker} marker is dated from the first co-authored commit in this site's own git history ({date}). Refresh the GitHub data with {cmd}.

claude.title: Claude Code lands
claude.note: Everything above this line was built with it. The commit weeks jump from single digits to forty-plus, and four new projects start within four months.

respeak.title: Back to Berlin: Respeak
respeak.note: First the SWR Tatort game, built for 100,000 concurrent players and launched with 18,000. Then tech lead on Experte, a RAG platform that cites every answer. Side projects kept going alongside.

msc.title: M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence
msc.note: Specialised in generative models and graduated with 8.25. Part-time alongside it at RWTH Aachen, just across the border, on identity-management apps for about 47,000 students and 9,000 staff.

bsc.title: B.Sc. Computer Science
bsc.note: Student developer at GT-ARC for most of the degree, working on multi-agent systems. Bachelor's thesis on genetic algorithms for shop scheduling.
